'''Nik Deleru''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|Male]] living on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. While on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] his mate, [[Ria Deleru|Ria]], left him. Nik believed her departure to be due to a kidnapping by the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] but instead his mate chose to work in the employ of the guild, dancing in their [[Migrant Merchants' Guild headquarters|headquarters]]. Her departure led Nik to seek the help of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. While arguing with [[Police officer/Legends|Police Officer]] [[Mal]], Deleru enlisted the help of an individual to locate Ria.

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Nik was highly possessive, often seeing his mate, Ria, as a possession rather than a person, even referring to her as his "most prized possession". He was also very outspoken, a trait which did not endear him to Coruscant security.

==Behind the scenes==
The quest to locate Ria in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' has two basic endings. The [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] choice has the player choosing to let Ria go, with Nik being told she was either taken off world, that she left him, or that she's dead. The [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] choice forces Ria to return to Nik, who sends her back to their homeworld; Ria manages to escape this fate by disappearing while the transport is docked on another world. Nik then believes she was kidnapped again.
